name: passtunnel
description: VPN status, logs and diagnosis for PassTunnel on macOS. Requires the PassTunnel app in /Applications.
long_description:
PassTunnel is a macOS VPN client for OpenVPN and FortiGate SSL VPN that fills in TOTP one-time codes automatically. This bundle starts the MCP server built into the installed app (`PassTunnel mcp`).

**Requires the PassTunnel app in /Applications** (Apple silicon, macOS 13 or later): `brew trust passtunnel/tap && brew install --cask passtunnel/tap/passtunnel`, or the disk image from https://github.com/passtunnel/passtunnel/releases/latest. The bundle contains only a small launcher script, not the app, and never downloads or installs anything; without the app the server stops with an install hint.

Read-only by default: list_profiles, get_status, get_logs (credentials redacted) and diagnose. connect and disconnect are offered only when "Allow connect and disconnect" is turned on; a profile protected with Touch ID still asks on your Mac. No tool returns passwords, TOTP secrets or one-time codes, and no tool creates, changes or deletes profiles. See SECURITY.md for the full model.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: Profiles with type, state, whether connecting asks for Touch ID, auto-reconnect

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: State, tunnel IP, since when, last error; whether the helper is installed and current

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: The last lines (up to 500) of a profile's VPN log, or of PassTunnel's activity log for it, with credentials redacted

tools.name: diagnose
tools.description: App version, helper state, and per profile whether config, server and saved credentials are in place

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Connect a profile (only with Allow connect and disconnect)

tools.name: disconnect
tools.description: Disconnect a profile (only with Allow connect and disconnect)

allow_connect.title: Allow connect and disconnect
allow_connect.description: Off: read-only (status, logs, diagnosis). On: also connect and disconnect profiles; profiles protected with Touch ID still ask on your Mac.
